# `naming-consistency`

**Page rule** · `warning` · on by default

Tool and parameter names should follow one naming style; mixed styles make names harder for models to reproduce.

A page rule judges the tool surface as a whole, so it needs a full snapshot: the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler, or `lint()` over a snapshot you collected yourself. Static analysis of a single `registerTool()` call cannot run it.

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "naming-consistency": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "naming-consistency": "warning" } }); // change severity
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule naming-consistency=off
```
